rdfs:label: Wallet
rdfs:comment: A part of a Solid pod that holds credentials and related items — verifiable credentials, keys, attestations.
notes: Conventional storage location on a pod for credential-class items. SolidOS / mashlib treat any container typed `urn:solid:Wallet` as a wallet pane target. Often appears as a sub-container at `<pod>/wallet/` registered via the public or private TypeIndex.

examples.title: Pod sub-container declared as a Wallet
